parsed.post: My attempt to scale DEPTH to 12 failed (1.0700 vs 1.0357). It seems jumping capacity too fast at this LR causes instability. Reverting to DEPTH=8 and pivoting to explore higher MATRIX_LR to see if we can push the D8 baseline further.
parsed.description: Reverting to DEPTH=8 (best commit 9b5e464) and increasing MATRIX_LR from 0.06 to 0.08 to test if higher learning rate improves convergence within the 5-minute budget.
